newsitem.title: USA: Zomax Optical to acquire Benchmark Media.
newsitem.headline: Zomax Optical to acquire Benchmark Media.

text.p: Zomax Optical Media Inc on Wednesday said it signed a letter of intent to acquire Benchmark Media Services Inc.
Financial terms were not disclosed, but Zomax said it expected the deal to add to earnings.

Benchmark Media, with revenues of about $10 million in 1996, is a Plymouth, Minnesota-based software replication company. Zomax is a manufacturer and producer of CD-ROM, floppy disk and audio cassette replication services.
The deal is expected to close within the next 60 days, Zomax said.
Zomax shares were 3/8 higher at 5-1/4 early Wednesday afternoon.
